arStrings.szText: Horadrim must often sacrifice the simple pleasures of life: comfort, kinship, romance.
Deckard Cain was one whose family was ripped from him long before he ever took up our mantle. Indeed, he was leery of our Order at the time.
Yet even still, it was his unrelenting obsession with research that drove his loved ones away. After his spouse took their son and left him, she and the boy were slaughtered by bandits.
Deckard was not Horadrim then—and yet, his challenge was so very Horadric.
This keepsake once belonged to Amelia Cain. I shall place it with Deckard’s things.
